gloss: to spread (a rumor) around; to tell everyone

definitions.gloss: to spread around; to tell everyone (something that should not be spread)
definitions.explanation: To go around telling many people something, typically a rumor, a secret or something untrue or hurtful. Carries disapproval of the person doing it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}いふらす。
⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}いふらさないで⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Please don't go telling everyone my secret.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{根|ね}も{葉|は}もない→根も葉もない：20624_nemohamonai⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}いふらして、⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とした→落とす：01246_otosu⟧。
examples.english: He spread baseless stories around and damaged his colleague's reputation.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive: what is spread takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ (⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}いふらす); also ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}いふらす to report what was said (⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}いふらす).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}いふらす: to spread a rumor
- ⟦{悪口|わるくち}→悪口：03794_warukuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}いふらす: to go around badmouthing someone
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}いふらす: to tell everyone someone's secret

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{広|ひろ}める→広める：02405_hiromeru⟧: to spread (neutral or positive: knowledge, a custom); {言|い}いふらす is always disapproving
- {触|ふ}れ{回|まわ}る: to go around announcing; close in meaning, also critical
